summary_1line: Viswamitra tries to seize Vasishtha’s divine cow Nandini, who magically defeats his army, leading Viswamitra to renounce kingship and pursue ascetic power.

image_candidates.scene_text: The divine cow Nandini, eyes blazing red, stands before Vasishtha while from her body erupt strange armies that surround and attack Viswamitra’s soldiers.
Viswamitra’s vast army flees in panic across the plains as supernatural warriors born from Nandini’s body chase them away from the hermitage.
The defeated king Viswamitra stands alone in the forest, casting aside royal power and resolving to pursue fierce ascetic penance.
